title: Vendor Panel basics
description: Dashboard, orders and payments, step by step on the demo venue's real transactions export (19 Sep – 19 Oct). From Rohan's Vendor Panel Training Plan.

modules.title: Dashboard
modules.summary: Pick a period, read the five figures, estimate the payout.

steps.title: Open the Dashboard
steps.instruction: Click Dashboard in the left menu. It's the first screen managers check each shift.
steps.say: Let's start on the Dashboard. Click it in the left menu.

steps.title: Open Time Settings
steps.instruction: Click the date button at the top right. It shows Today by default.
steps.say: Click the date button at the top right.

steps.title: Pick a period
steps.instruction: Choose Last 30 Days. You can also pick Today, Yesterday, This Week, Last 7 Days, This Month or a Custom range.
steps.note: Watch out: “Today” is the venue's business day, 3:00 AM to 2:59 AM the next morning, not midnight to midnight.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instruction: Click Confirm to apply the period.

steps.title: Everything updates
steps.instruction: Every figure now reads “Last 30 Days”. The period you pick carries across to Orders and Payments too.
steps.say: All figures update to the period you picked, and it carries across tabs.

steps.title: Revenue
steps.instruction: Bill amounts paid by card or wallet. It excludes tips, fees and loyalty credit.
steps.say: Revenue is the bill amount paid by card or wallet. No tips, no fees, no loyalty credit.

steps.title: Tips
steps.instruction: Tips guests added on top of the bill. They belong to the venue.

steps.title: Refunds
steps.instruction: Money returned to guests in the period.

steps.title: Diner Fee
steps.instruction: qlub's fee, paid by the guest on top of the bill. It is not venue money.

steps.title: Vendor Fee
steps.instruction: qlub's fee charged to the venue.

steps.title: Switch the chart
steps.instruction: Click Tips to switch the chart from bill revenue to tips per day.

steps.title: Tap a day
steps.instruction: Click 29 Sep on the chart.

steps.title: Split by card brand
steps.instruction: The right panel splits that day by card brand: Visa, Mastercard, Loyalty.
steps.note: Loyalty here is club credit redeemed, not a card.

steps.title: Popular Items
steps.instruction: Your top 10 items by units sold, with average price.
steps.note: Popular Items has its own range dropdown. It does not follow the date button.

steps.title: Open the payout
steps.instruction: Click “How it adds up” to see what qlub will pay the venue for the period.
steps.say: Let's work out the payout. Open the breakdown.

steps.title: How it adds up
steps.instruction: Payout = Revenue + Tips + Loyalty credit − Vendor Fee − Refunds. Last 30 days: $2,001.79 + $185.55 + $28.32 − $57.54 = $2,158.12.
steps.note: The Diner Fee goes to qlub, so it's never part of the payout. Payments by qlub wallet ($5.50 here) are settled separately.
steps.say: Revenue plus tips plus loyalty credit, minus the vendor fee and any refunds. The diner fee goes to qlub.

steps.title: What qlub pays the venue
steps.instruction: Receivable from qlub: $2,152.62 for the last 30 days. It matches the transactions export.
steps.say: For the last thirty days, qlub owes the venue two thousand one hundred and fifty-two dollars and sixty-two cents.

checks.question: A guest paid at 1:30 AM on Saturday. Which business day does it count in?
checks.explain: Right. The business day runs 3:00 AM to 2:59 AM, so 1:30 AM Saturday still belongs to Friday.

checks.question: A guest pays a $100 bill + $10 tip + $2.60 diner fee. How much goes into Revenue?
checks.explain: Right. Revenue is the bill only: tips and the diner fee are counted separately.

checks.question: On 29 Sep, how much was paid with Mastercard?
checks.explain: Right. Tap 29 Sep on the chart and the card split shows Mastercard $30.50.

checks.question: Revenue $500, Tips $40, Refunds $20, Vendor Fee $14, no loyalty credit. What's the payout?
checks.explain: Right. 500 + 40 − 20 − 14 = $506. The diner fee isn't added: it goes to qlub.

modules.title: Orders
modules.summary: Read the orders list, find an order, look inside, track tables live.

steps.title: Open Orders
steps.instruction: Click Orders in the left menu.

steps.title: One row = one bill
steps.instruction: Bill Amount is the table's full bill. Paid Amount is what's been settled so far.

steps.title: Customer Paid
steps.instruction: Paid + Tip + qlub Diner Fee. Table 1: $113.00 + $17.20 + $1.70 = $131.90.

steps.title: Status and Remaining
steps.instruction: Fully paid means $0 left. Partially Paid means the Remaining amount is still owed.
steps.note: A purple Loyalty tag means part of the bill was paid with club credit.

steps.title: Filter by status
steps.instruction: Click the Status filter.

steps.title: Show tables that still owe
steps.instruction: Choose Partially Paid.

steps.title: Search by Order ID
steps.instruction: You can also paste the 10-digit Order ID from the guest's receipt, or search by Table Name.
steps.note: Nothing showing? Widen the date range first.

steps.title: Open an order
steps.instruction: Click details on Table 2's order.

steps.title: Each payment
steps.instruction: Top: every payment with time, tip, method, last 4 digits and status. Split bills show one line per guest.

steps.title: What's left to pay
steps.instruction: Remaining is what the table still owes: $169.20 on this bill.

steps.title: The items
steps.instruction: Middle: the items, synced from the POS, with quantity, unit price and line total.
steps.note: Items don't match the POS bill? That's a POS sync issue: escalate in the venue's WhatsApp support group.

steps.title: Print or Download
steps.instruction: Bottom: give a guest or manager a copy of the bill.

steps.title: Close the order
steps.instruction: Click the X to close it.

steps.title: Open Table View
steps.instruction: Click Table View in the left menu. Keep it open on the floor to see every open bill.

steps.title: Read the colours
steps.instruction: Yellow: partially paid, still owes. Light green: paid, including loyalty. Green: fully paid (a heart means a tip).
steps.note: Confirm the exact light-green meaning with Product before go-live.

steps.title: Open a yellow table
steps.instruction: Table 2 is yellow. Click it to see the details.

steps.title: Check what's still owed
steps.instruction: Remaining shows what the table still owes: $169.20.
steps.note: Guest says “we've paid” but the table is yellow? Check Remaining first.

checks.question: Table 2 shows Partially Paid with $169.20 remaining. Can the guests leave?
checks.explain: Right. Partially Paid means the Remaining amount is still owed.

checks.question: How do you show only the tables that still owe money?
checks.explain: Right. Filter Status to Partially Paid.

checks.question: How did the guest on table 2 (16 Oct) pay, and was it accepted?
checks.explain: Right. The order's payment line shows qlubcardwallet, Accepted.

checks.question: A guest says “we've paid” but their table is yellow. What do you check?
options: The Remaining amount on that table
checks.explain: Right. Remaining tells you exactly what's still owed.

modules.title: Payments & Refunds
modules.summary: Match a payment to a guest, read statuses, issue a refund.

lessons.title: Match a payment to a guest

steps.title: Open Payments
steps.instruction: Click Payments in the left menu.

steps.title: One row per guest payment
steps.instruction: Each row is one guest's payment, so a split bill shows several rows. Rows with no method are loyalty credit.

steps.title: Search
steps.instruction: Search by order ID, the card's last 4 digits, the card brand or the amount. Try typing 4242.

steps.title: Read the status
steps.instruction: Filter by status: Accepted, Rejected or Refunded.
steps.note: Rejected = the card was declined and no money was taken. Ask the guest to pay again.

steps.title: Find the payment
steps.instruction: Table 1 paid $131.90 by Visa ending 4242. The guest says they were overcharged.

steps.title: Open the menu
steps.instruction: Click ⋮ at the end of the row.

steps.title: Choose Refund
steps.instruction: Click Refund. (Print gives a receipt instead.)
steps.note: For this lesson you're signed in as a manager. On a staff login Refund is greyed out: ask a manager with refund access.

steps.title: Enter the amount
steps.instruction: Choose Full, or Partial and enter an amount.
steps.note: Concept screen: the real dialog still needs capturing with a manager login.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instruction: Click Refund to confirm.

steps.title: Done
steps.instruction: The status changes to Refunded, and the Dashboard's Refunds figure goes up.

checks.question: A guest with a Visa ending 4242 says they paid on 16 Oct. Which payment is theirs?
checks.explain: Right. Search 4242 and pick the 16 Oct row: order 5551688701, $131.90.

checks.question: You can't click Refund. What do you do?
options: Ask a manager with refund access
Tell the guest refunds aren't possible
checks.explain: Right. Refunds need a permission: a manager with refund access can do it.

checks.question: A payment shows Rejected. What does that mean?
options: The card was declined and no money was taken
checks.explain: Right. Ask the guest to pay again.

faqs.q: How do I refund a guest?
faqs.a: Payments → find the Accepted payment → ⋮ → Refund → enter the amount → confirm. No Refund option? Ask a manager with refund access.

faqs.q: How do I see yesterday's or previous days' data?
faqs.a: Click the date button at the top right and pick Yesterday, Last 7 Days or a Custom range. The period carries across Dashboard, Orders and Payments.
Bill amounts paid by card or wallet. Tips, the Diner Fee and loyalty credit are not part of Revenue.
Revenue + Tips + Loyalty credit − Vendor Fee − Refunds. The Diner Fee goes to qlub. The Dashboard's Estimated payout card shows the breakdown; settlement dates: check with Finance.

faqs.q: A guest says they paid but the table is yellow
faqs.a: Yellow means partially paid. Open Table View, click the table and check Remaining: that's what's still owed.

faqs.q: How do I find a specific order?
faqs.a: Orders → set the date → search by Table Name or paste the Order ID from the receipt. Nothing showing? Widen the date range.

faqs.q: A guest wants a copy of their bill
faqs.a: Orders → click details on the order → Print or Download.

faqs.q: The guest's card was charged twice
faqs.a: Payments → search the order ID or last 4 digits and check each row's status. Rejected means no money was taken. Two Accepted rows for one share? Refund one, or ask a manager.
Each guest pays their share and Payments shows one row per guest. The order stays Partially Paid until Remaining reaches $0.
